decision: Focused development verification passed. Full integrated regression and source-bound CI remain required before release-readiness claims.
scope: Synthetic Linux development-host private callback storage, encrypted recovery and loopback HTTP. This is not a selected-host capacity result, public deployment, real-user test, or release approval.

source.manifestQualification: The full working-tree manifest includes the final reusable harness. Its candidate-only smoke passed on this source. Original paired measurements use their separately preserved harness version. Focused test/runtime code remains unchanged; full integrated CI is pending.

fixtureSpecification.fixtureCreation: 500 actual createLead operations, 2000 actual createCallbackTask operations, 18000 actual reschedule operations
fixtureSpecification.transcripts: Ten customer messages of 2000 UTF-16 code units per request
fixtureSpecification.taskStateAtRead: 2000 scheduled tasks, each at version 10; 500 requests each at version 41
fixtureSpecification.dueOrder: Task index order interleaves 500 distinct requests per 500-row page
fixtureSpecification.identifiers: Separately generated random UUIDs and password salts. The two datasets are not byte-identical.
fixtureSpecification.databaseByteHashStatus: Not captured before temporary fixtures were removed. No byte-level dataset identity is claimed.

comparisonQualification: Separately generated fixtures follow one captured specification. Their random identifiers and salts differ. Host scheduling, caches and garbage collection were not controlled. These observations do not establish a service-level objective or a statistical performance guarantee.

independentReview.counting: Overlaps focused verification; do not add as distinct cases or new platform coverage.

excludedObservations.description: The fifth sequential 500-row page used offset 2000. The application correctly returned an empty page. The harness incorrectly required 500 rows, so the attempt stopped before concurrent HTTP measurement. The repaired harness wraps page offsets within the fixture.

reproduction.futureFixtureIdentity: The reusable harness records the checkpointed SQLite file SHA-256 and size before backup, plus runtime hashes before and after the run. It deletes temporary synthetic records after completion.
reproduction.timingGate: No absolute latency threshold is encoded. Tests assert bounded database statement counts and no full request-history materialization, plus actual recovery correctness.

reusableHarnessVerification.scope: Candidate-only normal-path smoke. Does not replace the original before/after comparison or add test-count credit.
reusableHarnessVerification.failureBranches: Network timeout, forced child termination and runtime source mutation were reviewed but not separately fault-injected in this smoke.
